title: Too much blank space in panel popup
line: Clicking a panel Timer that only shows a progress bar now opens a popup with the time, instead of a big empty one.
explanation: The Timer's popup hid its digits whenever 'Show remaining time' was off, although that option is meant for what the panel shows. With only the progress bar enabled, the panel popup was a large empty area with one thin bar and the time could not be set there. The change keeps the digits visible in the popup of a panel timer, as in the open MR kdeplasma-addons!1235; desktop timers still follow the option.

commits.message:
applets/timer: always show the time in the panel popup

"Show remaining time" decides what the panel shows. With it off, the popup
was a big empty area around a thin progress bar and the time couldn't be
set. The popup of a panel timer now always shows the digits.

BUG: 488937

patches.diff:
From a4e06693b23b8708489897db231e64ff2ad5a918 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 16:34:49 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/timer: always show the time in the panel popup

"Show remaining time" decides what the panel shows. With it off, the popup
was a big empty area around a thin progress bar and the time couldn't be
set. The popup of a panel timer now always shows the digits.

BUG: 488937
---
 applets/timer/TimerView.qml | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/applets/timer/TimerView.qml b/applets/timer/TimerView.qml
index dc1f94e40..d50b72461 100644
--- a/applets/timer/TimerView.qml
+++ b/applets/timer/TimerView.qml
@@ -89,7 +89,7 @@ MouseArea {
             Layout.fillWidth: true
             Layout.fillHeight: true
             Layout.verticalStretchFactor: 3
-            visible: Plasmoid.configuration.showRemainingTime
+            visible: Plasmoid.configuration.showRemainingTime || fullRepresentation.inPanel
 
             value: fullRepresentation.seconds
             editable: !fullRepresentation.running
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Timer in the panel with only the progress bar: the popup is empty except for a thin bar
Same setup with the fix: the popup shows the time above the progress bar, the panel still shows only the bar

review.text: Clean one-line fix in TimerView.qml that keeps the editable timer digits visible in panel popups regardless of showRemainingTime, while leaving desktop timers and the compact panel representation untouched. This eliminates the nearly empty popup with only a thin progress bar and aligns with the open MR !1235 and the timer configuration rework !1242. Before/after screenshots confirm the panel still shows only the progress bar while the popup now displays usable digits.

reviews.text: Clean one-line fix in TimerView.qml that keeps the editable timer digits visible in panel popups regardless of showRemainingTime, while leaving desktop timers and the compact panel representation untouched. This eliminates the nearly empty popup with only a thin progress bar and aligns with the open MR !1235 and the timer configuration rework !1242. Before/after screenshots confirm the panel still shows only the progress bar while the popup now displays usable digits.

Showing the digits in the panel popup whatever 'Show remaining time' says is the right UX: the popup becomes useful and you can set the time there. It is a clean one-line change in TimerView, and the screenshots prove it on first open. But the reporter's steps end with 'Restart to finalize the layout, then click on the timer widget again', and the fixer's own notes say that after a plasmashell restart the popup reopens at a stored 560x400 size with huge digits and a lot of empty space below. That is still 'too much blank space in panel popup' in the exact scenario reported, so the bug isn't fully closed.
changes: Fix the popup reopening at the oversized stored size (560x400) after a plasmashell restart, or show that it is a generic Plasma popup-size issue handled elsewhere, so the panel popup stays compact after the restart in the reporter's step 5.
Add before/after evidence of the popup after a plasmashell restart.
